item.text:
This pass checked the execution consequence of F25. In the F1-fixed seed-6 reproduction, all five replicas commit an empty command but `ExecedUpTo` stays at `-1`, so the instance never executes ([output](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/diagnostic_fix5_seed6_debug_output.txt)). The empty commit is therefore not a harmless marker: it stalls execution instead of advancing the explicit NOOP that the guarded recovery path produces.

That strengthens the F25 impact already documented: the missing `len(cmds) > 0` check can leave all replicas COMMITTED on an unexecutable empty command.

The audit remains at **27 findings**, **42 failing finding tests**, and **5 passing controls**; the captured source is unchanged and builds cleanly. The execution evidence is recorded in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/report.md), with the existing [executive summary](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/executive_summary.md), [validation matrix](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/validation_matrix.md), [remediation map](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/remediation.md), and [handoff check](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/handoff_check.txt).
